# Patient RX System v2.0.61

## Dashboard Trends, Analytics Pagination, and Production Report Prep

- Added Daily Snapshot metrics for Dashboard trend reporting, including active/inactive patients, patients with no RX records, total RX records, pending deliveries, eligibility, active window, missing service date, workflow completion, and activity counters.
- Added Dashboard graph cards for patients, RX/workflow, eligibility, and workflow completion with shared date-range controls and CSV export support.
- Removed Login Activity from the main Dashboard while keeping login/activity metrics available through snapshots and backoffice reporting.
- Fixed snapshot date handling so date-only values are interpreted on the local calendar day instead of drifting because of UTC parsing.
- Added server-side pagination to Backoffice Analytics so large snapshot histories load faster.
- Fixed Patient Report and RX Action Report pagination selectors so selected page sizes actually limit visible rows.
- Defaulted Patient Management filters to active patients so Dashboard counts match list views unless inactive records are intentionally included.
- Preserved staging/development bulk-data tooling for QA coverage while keeping that path out of production use.

## Database Impact

- Adds nullable/defaulted columns to `DailySnapshots` through migration `20260628103000-add-dashboard-trend-metrics-to-daily-snapshots.js`.
- No patient, RX, pharmacy, clinic, or transport production records are transformed.
- Existing snapshots remain valid; new trend fields populate as daily snapshots are captured after deployment.
- Rollback to v2.0.60 should be package-only for runtime behavior, though the added snapshot columns may remain unless the migration is explicitly reverted.

## Validation

- JavaScript syntax checks passed for modified controllers, services, frontend files, and migration files.
- Database migration command completed successfully.
- Production executable build completed successfully.
- `dist/server.exe --v` reported `2.0.61`.
- Production update archive `dist/server-update-2.0.61.zip` was generated with release notes included.
